purpose: Teach: エンジェル/ルーマニア/ミレニアム/ギルド/ワイドショー/クリエイター/サイレント/ロフト

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、エンジェルのキャラ好きだったよな
lines.en: Hey Riku — you used to like that Angel character, remember?
lines.style: Casual tease, landing gently on the memory. Half-smile in the voice. Testing him with something she knows. Quick, comfortable rhythm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でルーマニアの場所言えなかったろ、桜
lines.en: You couldn't even point out Romania on a map in geography class, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, quick comeback. Light laugh underneath — not mean, just matching her energy. Eyes narrow slightly. Beat of satisfaction.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ミレニアム世代って言葉使うようになったな
lines.en: Wait, since when do you use words like 'millennial generation'?
lines.style: Caught him in something. Eyebrow up. Curiosity with a thread of mock-accusation. Leans in slightly, genuinely wondering.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゲームのギルドに入ったろ?桜
lines.en: Didn't you join that guild in the game you're always playing?
lines.style: Flipping it back at him. Lighter now — less teasing, more wondering aloud. Genuine interest underneath. Slower pace on 'guild'.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお父さん、朝のワイドショー出てたな
lines.en: Your dad was on that morning talk show the other day, wasn't he?
lines.style: Observation stated like a fact, but with curiosity underneath. Not accusatory. Warm, wondering how he felt about it. Patient wait for his answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、クリエイター志望って言ってたな、桜
lines.en: You told me you wanted to be a creator or something like that.
lines.style: Remembering something he said. Soft certainty in the tone. Not pressing, just confirming she was listening. Slight upturn at 'something like that' — gentle.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、映画部でサイレント映画観てたな
lines.en: You were watching silent films with the film club, right?
lines.style: Knowing detail, lightly delivered. Slight smile — she's filed this away about him. Curious about why. Open ending, inviting him to explain.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家のロフトに秘密基地作ってたろ、桜
lines.en: You built a secret hideout in your loft at home, didn't you?
lines.style: Dry, amused. She's got him caught — knows something private about him and is calling it out with affection, not judgment. Slight laugh at the end.
